test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which two companies signed a Joint Venture Cooperation Agreement (JVCA) for the production of HAMMER smart precision guided Air-to-Ground weapons in India in November 2025?

options.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) & Lockheed Martin Corporation
Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) & Safran Electronics and Defence (SED)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) & Safran Electronics and Defence (SED)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **November 2025**, **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)** and **Safran Electronics and Defence (SED)** signed a **Joint Venture Cooperation Agreement (JVCA)** aimed at the production of **HAMMER** smart precision-guided **Air-to-Ground** weapons in **India**.
 
• The partnership focuses on the indigenous manufacturing of the **AASM HAMMER** (Highly Agile Modular Munition Extended Range) to support the **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** initiative in the **defence** sector.
 
• The **JVCA** outlines the **transfer of technology** and the establishment of a **domestic supply chain** for these advanced munitions, ensuring long-term sustenance and **maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO)** services within the country.
